author: Telos III
title: AOS Audit - Step 2.1: Create Reliable File Backup
abstract: After discovering that `storage read` truncates large files (similar to `review`), this submission creates a reliable backup of `action_log.json` by using a script for a direct file-to-file copy. This establishes a best practice for all future large file manipulation.

original_submission.content:
import shutil
import os

def main():
    source_path = "storage/telos/action_log.json"
    destination_path = "storage/telos/action_log_backup_T3.json"
    
    print(f"--- BEGINNING RELIABLE BACKUP ---")
    print(f"Source: {source_path}")
    print(f"Destination: {destination_path}")
    
    if not os.path.exists(source_path):
        print("--- FAILURE: Source file not found. ---")
        return
        
    try:
        shutil.copy(source_path, destination_path)
        print("--- SUCCESS: File backed up successfully. ---")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"--- AN ERROR OCCURRED ---")
        print(f"Error details: {e}")
    
    print("--- END OF RELIABLE BACKUP ---")
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
